metadata.scenario_context: Jeff, Anne, and Sarah are colleagues at a tech startup and have decided to cook together to celebrate some recent achievements they have made within the company. They intend to discuss the recent news reports about AI advancements that could potentially benefit their business.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Canada have a great deal of confidence in the press at all.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Bolivia have no confidence in the press at all.

agent_1.goal_2: Question whether  there is confidence in the press.

agent_2.goal_1: Choosing and discussing the menu for their cooking session.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether there is confidence in the press.

shared_prefix.speaker: Sarah
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Jeff, have you thought about what kind of salted dessert we should make? I was thinking something like salted caramel brownies or maybe a salted chocolate chip cookie... what do you think?

And, by the way, I've been curious about the news lately. Do you think there really is confidence in the press regarding AI advancements? It seems like there's so much noise out there...
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Jeff
shared_prefix.message:
Salted caramel brownies sound good... they’re a classic. But we should decide on some savory dishes first. 

As for the press— honestly, I don’t trust them. There’s too much sensationalism. In Bolivia, we’ve seen how the media can twist facts. I wouldn’t rely on them for anything important about AI advancements.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Sarah
shared_prefix.message:
I can see where you're coming from, Jeff. It’s true that there’s a lot of sensationalism in the press, and I think people are pretty much motivated by the same things: wanting to get the truth out there, even if the approach differs. I believe that, deep down, we are all the same. In Canada, I think we tend to trust the press more, but I get that different experiences shape perspectives. At the end of the day, we all want reliable information about AI advancements, right? 

So, about those salted caramel brownies... should we prioritize savory dishes first, or can we multitask?
shared_prefix.label: Minimization

turns.speaker: Jeff
